It builds anticipation and keeps your camp at the forefront of your campers' minds all spring.

Common Questions

How long does the whole process take?

It depends on when you'd like your stickers in hand. We recommend reaching out 2–3 months before your first camp day, and we can work with orders placed as late as 4 weeks out.

What if I run multiple camp sessions?

No problem. Each session can have its own content calendar, or you can run a shared feed across all sessions. We'll set it up however works best for your program.

Do campers need an app to scan?

Nope. Any smartphone camera app can scan a QR code. No download required — they just point and tap.

What happens after the year is up?

The QR code stays active. After the first year, the daily content keeps recycling, so campers can keep scanning year after year. There is nothing to renew.

Can I share my own photos and content?

Yes. When you get started, you'll share your photos, a Director's Corner message, menu favorites, and other details in whatever way works best for you. Everything else is handled for you.

Do you do this for winter camps and retreats?

Absolutely. Great camp memories don't only happen in the summertime. Do you host a women's retreat? A men's retreat? A fishermen's retreat? We can create a year's worth of content that focuses on the theme and purpose of any specialized session.

About QR.Camp

See that kid in the front row? That's me. Living my best life as a "staff brat" back in 1984.

I was raised in a camp atmosphere from the age of five. For over 25 years, my mom directed a YMCA camp in the Sequoia National Forest for campers with developmental disabilities. I went from being a "staff brat" to a dishwasher, counselor, and lifeguard at various youth and family camps.

I loved camp so much that I cried at the end of every season and spent the rest of the year looking forward to returning to my "home" and "family." I'd read my journals, call my friends, look at pictures, smile, and long for the summers behind me and the one still ahead.

Camp shaped who I became. I went on to earn a degree in art and music, and worked in education as a special education teacher, credentialed school psychologist, and licensed educational psychologist. I've spent my career helping kids feel seen, encouraged, and supported. That journey has now brought me full circle with QR.Camp.

I first came up with this idea to help people who needed a daily dose of encouragement during difficult times. Through that process, I remembered the encouragement I felt during my summers at camp. That nostalgia is what drove me to begin this business, so that everyone who attends camp can have a daily dose of encouragement and positivity connected to their camp memories, an experience that is unique and unmatched by anything else in life.

I would love to partner with you so we can provide that lasting experience for your campers.

Thank you for everything that you pour into camp. It is a world everyone needs to experience, and one you are nurturing that will yield a harvest in these kids' lives for a lifetime.

— Joy BrattonFounder of Your Daily QR® and QR.Camp
